sources.split_mapping: BEIR SciFact test.tsv query IDs and texts exactly match original SciFact claims_dev.jsonl (300/300), not claims_test.jsonl; this release-level naming mismatch was verified after the initial path assertion failed.

retriever.name: BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5
retriever.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
retriever.score: exact inner product over normalized float32 embeddings

conditions.T1: zero-shot BGE top-1 full abstract then frozen Qwen
conditions.T_gold: first numeric annotated evidence document then frozen Qwen; only if original TEST labels are genuinely available

verification_availability_policy.available_only_if: official claims_test records contain a non-withheld mixture of explicit evidence annotations with valid SUPPORT/CONTRADICT labels; missing evidence or an all-empty evidence field is treated as withheld, not INSUFFICIENT
verification_availability_policy.if_unavailable: run and validate T1 predictions but do not compute verification accuracy/F1, evidence diagnostics, error decomposition, or T_gold

gold_document_rule: first numeric annotated evidence document, matching Milestone 5A D3

uncertainty.method: ordinary query bootstrap because frozen DEV related-claim groups do not cover TEST

stop_rule: Stop after the one-time frozen TEST evaluation; no post-TEST tuning or ablation.
